name: uso-bateria
description: Clawd beside a pixel battery of your weekly Claude usage, in a small panel of the Claude Desktop app

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: panel: a small panel the app places and moves as panels open and close, beside any background. fondo: painted on the window background, placed with Position or /bateria-mover

position.title: Position
position.description: Mode fondo only: where the card sits beside the chat column; the bottom spots sit level with the prompt box. /bateria-mover places it with a click

size.title: Size
size.description: How big the battery card is

style.title: Style
style.description: compact: one low strip; full: the original tall card

opacity.title: Card background
opacity.description: How solid the card's dark background is

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the card's text: es (Spanish) or en (English)

mobile.title: On the phone
mobile.description: Also show the card in the Claude mobile app (it sits behind the messages there)
